learning.platform_recovery: The exact repo-backed staging service can be replaced/restarted and returns to Railway health in about 1.4 seconds from container start; total requested redeploy to health was about 30.4 seconds including build/platform orchestration.
learning.external_verification: Recovery is not accepted from Railway status alone; an independent GitHub runner re-proved release identity, public surfaces and unauthenticated fail-closed behavior after replacement.
learning.next_proof: Measure customer-impact continuity during a deliberately induced hosted failure with redundant capacity or safe failover, then wire WFM's own deterministic repair signal to the platform recovery capability rather than invoking redeploy manually.

claim_boundary: Staging/customer-proof resilience evidence only. This proves successful platform replacement/restart and outside-in recovery of the exact hosted staging candidate; it does not prove production HA, zero-downtime failover, authenticated customer-journey continuity or WFM-triggered autonomous Railway repair.
